The flowchart starts from "desert" and connects upward to the planting link, including the planting of plants such as "salix, poplar forest" and "licorice, Cistanche, etc."; then it further connects to "biomanufacturing" and "biopharmaceuticals", and finally points to the "market", with the "Science and Technology Development Department" in the middle playing a supporting role. Then reason: desert areas first carry out ecological governance and vegetation restoration by planting drought-resistant plants, and on this basis develop industries such as biomanufacturing and biopharmaceuticals and enter the market, indicating that this model is not simply developing the desert, but takes ecological governance as the starting point and foundation, and uses governance results to drive the development of the industrial chain. Therefore, the relationship between ecological governance and industrial development handled by the "Kubuqi model" is: based on ecological governance, promote industrial development.
